omar (cust): Hi team — after we pinned our account to a specific embed variant yesterday, our embeddings suddenly dropped from length 1536 -> 1024 for many requests. This broke our similarity index. Anyone seen this?

jia (support): Sorry — can you paste a minimal request + response you saw? Is this only for the pinned deployment or also for hosted?

omar (cust): Only for the pinned model we set in our tenant (we used the dashboard 'pin variant' UI). Minimal curl we run:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-open-embed-v2","input":["hello world"]}'
```
Response (truncated):```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,0.002,... /* vector length 1024 */ ]}],"model":"rwd-open-embed-v2"}```

sasha (ml): Thanks — two quick possibilities: 1) the pinned model resolved to a quantized/compat variant with 1024 output; 2) a fallback routing switched to an older embedding family. Can you share the X-Model-Version header you sent (if any) or the tenant pin ID?

omar (cust): We didn't set X-Model-Version. Pin ID is pin_9a7f. We only used the dashboard pin, no explicit headers. We also saw intermittent 502s earlier today and a spike in latency around the same time.

infra-bot: alert: Increased 5xx rate detected for tenant pin_9a7f between 2025-11-02T14:03:00Z and 2025-11-02T14:12:00Z.

jia (support): OK this looks like a pinned-variant resolution + routing fallback issue. Quick repro steps: 1) call embeddings with explicit model and variant: `{"model":"rwd-open-embed-v2","variant":"float16-standard"}` 2) check model metadata: `GET /v1/models/rwd-open-embed-v2` to confirm output dimension. Can you run that and paste the GET response?

omar (cust): Ran the variant explicit call — embedding length returned 1536. GET model metadata shows: `default_variant: "auto"`, `variants: ["float16-standard","quant-8-1024"]`. So auto default apparently picked the quantized variant after pin.

sasha (ml): That's the root cause — the pin saved the model name but our resolver allowed a variant alias that maps to a quantized 1024-dim artifact when capacity for float16 was constrained. There's a known edge case where pinned entries can still resolve to variant aliases when the pin doesn't include variant metadata. We'll treat this as a bug.

maria (acct): Omar — I see you were billed for the requests during the window. We'll pause billing adjustments while this is investigated; please confirm if you want a usage credit for the affected timeframe.

omar (cust): Yes please, credit for the period where vectors changed. Also we need a way to enforce only 1536-dim outputs regardless of routing.

jia (support): Short-term mitigation: include `"variant":"float16-standard"` in your embeddings calls; or set the tenant pin to the fully-qualified variant name in the console (pin to rwd-open-embed-v2:float16-standard). I'll open a support ticket to update your pin.

sasha (ml): Long-term fix: we'll add validation in the pin resolver so pins without variant metadata default to the model's canonical full-dim variant instead of aliasing to smaller quantized variants. Also adding an alert rule to warn when embedding dimensionality for a tenant deviates from the last known baseline.

omar (cust): Quick question — could batching or batchpad have caused truncation/concat that looks like a dim change? We batch many short inputs.

sasha (ml): Unlikely to change vector length. Batching can cause pad/truncate *within* a request payload but not change model output dimension. The fact that explicit variant returns 1536 proves the model artifact itself differed. We'll also inspect the gateway routing logs for pin_9a7f.

jia (support): I've created ticket SF-4821 and assigned to eng-ml. Action items: support -> update your pin to fully-qualified variant (we can do it for you), eng-ml -> root cause + resolver patch, infra -> check for capacity-caused fallbacks during the window, billing -> review credits.

omar (cust): Thanks, please copy me on the ticket and timeline. We depend on fixed vector size for our search indexes.

infra-bot: ticket SF-4821 created and assigned to eng-ml, priority P1.

sasha (ml): I'll follow up with a short postmortem when we have the fix. For now lock to explicit variant in your client to avoid surprises. :thumbsup:

jia (support): Closing loop — I'm updating the tenant pin now to include variant. Omar I'll DM you the change and the temporary credit estimate.

omar (cust): Appreciate it.
